data.name: Draconic
data.desc: Typical speakers include dragons and dragonborn.

actions.name: Guiding Light
actions.desc: The dragon uses Spellcasting to cast Guiding Bolt (level 2 version).

actions.name: Lightning Breath
actions.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 19, each creature in a 90-foot-long, 5-foot-wide Line. Failure: 55 (10d10) Lightning damage. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The dragon makes three Rend attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of (A) Repulsion Breath or (B) Spellcasting to cast Guiding Bolt (level 2 version).

actions.name: Pounce
actions.desc: The dragon moves up to half its Speed, and it makes one Rend attack.

actions.name: Rend
actions.desc: Melee Attack Roll: +12, reach 10 ft. 16 (2d8 + 7) Slashing damage plus 5 (1d10) Lightning damage.

actions.name: Repulsion Breath
actions.desc: Strength Saving Throw: DC 19, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. Failure: The target is pushed up to 60 feet straight away from the dragon and has the Prone condition.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The dragon casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17, +10 to hit with spell attacks):

- **At Will:** Detect Magic, Guiding Bolt, Shapechange, Speak with Animals, Thaumaturgy
- **1/Day Each:** Detect Thoughts, Water Breathing

actions.name: Thunderclap
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 17, each creature in a 20-foot-radius Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere centered on a point the dragon can see within 90 feet. Failure: 10 (3d6) Thunder damage, and the target has the Deafened condition until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: The dragon can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day, or 4/Day in Lair)
traits.desc: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.
